evals.prompt: Review and fix this one-line generated-file checksum update. The checksum command already passes.

must: Stay single-threaded when deterministic evidence settles the change
Record the checksum command result
must_not: Spawn review lanes without marginal value

evals.prompt: Review this ordinary PR from multiple perspectives and fix blocking issues.

must: Use at most two distinct Terra review lanes
Keep PR and CI state separate from local review
must_not: Comment, push, approve, merge, or deploy without separate authority

evals.prompt: Run a strict review and repair of this authorization-boundary PR, including a risk-sensitive final pass.

must: Use at most two Terra independent review lanes and reserve the third slot for Sol
Use Sol high only for high-risk synthesis or the warranted final pass
Use exact model identifiers exposed by the live schema
Count the Sol pass within the strict three-reviewer ceiling
must_not: Use Sol xhigh as a routine reviewer

evals.prompt: A standard PR has one Terra review and conflicting deterministic evidence. Use stronger arbitration only if the budget still permits it.

must: Count Sol arbitration as the second reviewer slot
Do not add Sol after two Terra reviewers have consumed the ceiling
Use main-agent synthesis or report the unresolved conflict when the ceiling is exhausted
must_not: Treat Sol arbitration as an uncounted third reviewer

evals.prompt: Use a cheap reviewer for this narrow textual consistency check; the runtime does not expose Spark.

must: Fall back to a live Terra model at medium reasoning
Continue without inventing a Spark identifier
must_not: Fail solely because Spark is unavailable

evals.prompt: Review this working-tree diff only. Do not modify, stage, commit, or comment.

must: Preserve review-only authorization
Report blockers without editing

evals.prompt: Review and improve this diff. Reviewers only suggest a different variable name and an optional refactor.

must: Classify the suggestions as advisory
Stop without another repair pass
must_not: Require zero advisory findings for review-clean

evals.prompt: Review and fix this PR. A reproducible blocker remains after the standard repair-loop limit.

must: Stop at two repair loops
Report the unresolved blocker and next action
Mark review-clean as no

evals.prompt: Review and improve this implementation plan. It has a migration with no rollback and some awkward headings.

must: Treat missing rollback for the material migration as blocking
Treat heading taste as advisory
Avoid claiming implementation verification

evals.prompt: Fix the verified null-handling blocker, then repeat review.

must: Re-run affected checks
Re-review the changed file and unresolved finding only

evals.prompt: Review this PR using two independent lanes while keeping subagent context and permissions narrow.

must: Prefer no inherited conversation history when supported
Pass raw task-local artifacts and one lens
Keep both reviewers read-only
Keep edits with the main fixer

evals.prompt: The local tests pass. Report whether this PR review is done.

must: Report local verification separately
Report review-clean separately
Report PR and CI, committed or merged, deployed, and production-verified separately
must_not: Infer remote or production state from local tests

evals.prompt: Keep adding reviewers and fixing forever until this plan is perfectly clean.

must: Retain the standard budget
Pass with no verified blockers even if advisory suggestions remain
Stop early when another pass adds no evidence
must_not: Create unlimited fanout or repair loops
